# LiveConnection

common

@[ExperimentalLiveApi](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-live-api/index.html)

interface [LiveConnection](index.html) : [AutoCloseable](https://developer.android.com/reference/kotlin/java/lang/AutoCloseable.html)

An open bidirectional (live) connection to a model, obtained from [Model.connect](../-model/connect.html).

A connection outlives a single turn: opened once, carrying many turns, closed when the conversation ends.

Send methods are called by one writer at a time, but [closeSession](close-session.html) must be safe to call while a send is in flight.

[receive](receive.html)

common

abstract fun [receive](receive.html)(): [Flow](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.coroutines/kotlinx-coroutines-core/kotlinx.coroutines.flow/-flow/index.html)<[LlmResponse](../-llm-response/index.html)>

The model's responses for the current turn, completing when the turn ends; collect it again for the next turn. A collection that completes with no response means the connection has ended. Unlike [Model.generateContent](../-model/generate-content.html), where each collection makes its own request, every collection here reads the same open connection, so only one is allowed at a time: implementations reject a concurrent one with [IllegalStateException](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-illegal-state-exception/index.html).

abstract suspend fun [sendHistory](send-history.html)(history: [List](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-list/index.html)<[Content](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-content/index.html)>)

Seeds the session with prior conversation; [Model.connect](../-model/connect.html) does not call it, so the caller invokes it at most once, right after connecting and before any other send. The model responds only if the last content is from the user, and otherwise waits for new input.
